title: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco 10ml Freebase E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape White Chocolate Hazelnut Tobacco Freebase is a layered, dessert-inspired Tobacco blend that balances indulgent notes with earthy depth. The Tobacco forms a robust base, while creamy White Chocolate adds mellow sweetness, and roasted Hazelnut brings a nutty warmth that completes the mix with character and complexity. Blended at either 40VG/60PG or 50VG/50PG depending on strength, this e-liquid ensures clear flavour definition and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping styles, it works best with starter kits, vape pens and refillable pod systems. Available in nicotine strengths from 0mg to 18mg, it offers a versatile choice for vapers who enjoy classic Tobacco enhanced with sweet and nutty accents. Made in the UK, Vampire Vape have a long-standing reputation for quality and innovation. Their Tobacco collection highlights bold combinations that go beyond the traditional, crafted for those who appreciate Tobacco blends with a modern twist.
